Tropical Weather Outlook
NWS National Hurricane Center Miami FL
800 PM EDT Tue Sep 22 2026

For the North Atlantic...Caribbean Sea and the Gulf of America:

Active Systems:
The National Hurricane Center has issued the last advisory on 
Post-Tropical Cyclone Fay, located several hundred miles southwest 
of the Azores.

Far Eastern Tropical Atlantic:
A tropical wave is forecast to move off the coast of western Africa 
later tonight or tomorrow. Although upper-level winds are not very 
conducive for development, a tropical depression could form while it 
moves generally northwestward across the far eastern Atlantic. 
Interests in the Cabo Verde Islands should monitor the progress of 
this system as gusty winds and areas of heavy rain are possible 
there by the end of the week.
* Formation chance through 48 hours...low...20 percent.
* Formation chance through 7 days...medium...40 percent.
